# Peace first: the AI builds no more than a little beyond its start army while the Golden King reigns
zin_default_peace_first = {
	allowed = {
		always = yes
	}
	enable = {
		zin_ai_era_peace = yes
	}
	abort_when_not_enabled = yes
	ai_strategy = {
		type = ai_wanted_divisions_factor
		value = -50
	}
}
